decisions.reason: As a newly launched multi-model machine line that builds directly on the firm's core automation offering and publicly supports its future-ready precast strategy, management is likely to continue backing it and interpret any early weakness as temporary.

Although software is slightly less central than the firm's core machinery business, it fits the announced push toward automated, data-driven plant solutions and the firm's integrated lifecycle offer, so prior R&D and public commitment make withdrawal within a year unlikely.
